svg.text: Accepted B control held · exact post-rescale sockets · transport first · review only
28u outer pipe · 22u liner · visible canister fits inside the lumen
SOURCE CELL = x/y 32…96 INSIDE THE 128u TWO-CELL FRAME
Every butt socket lands at W (32,64), E (96,64), or S (64,96). Rounded endcaps never sit on a segment boundary.
Couplers live inside the cell; wall collar and riser hardware wrap one uninterrupted centerline.
Cell-edge guides cross painted pipe at
all three seams. The wall collar and riser
wrap the centerline instead of replacing it.
FAR ROUTE STRIP · SAME COMPOSED SVG
Canisters remain discrete objects; the route remains a pipe, never a UI line or conveyor belt.
• canister is narrower than the lumen
• joins read as one uninterrupted pipe
• station / node / riser remain separable nouns
• no meters, routing arrows, or baked status color
